name: Residential Properties
definition: URA overall private residential property sale-price index, covering landed and non-landed property; 2009 Q1 = 100. Stratified hedonic regression is used from 2015 Q1.
update_frequency: Quarterly. URA states that its time-series service updates on the fourth Friday of January, April, July and October, or the following working day after a public holiday. This upstream schedule is not a guaranteed SingStat mirror update time; individual historical release dates are not reconstructed.
table_title: Private Residential Property Price Index By Type Of Property, (1st Quarter 2009 = 100), Quarterly
source_footnote: From 1Q 2015, the private residential property price indices are computed using a stratified hedonic regression method.  Under this method, variations in the attributes of private residential properties transacted such as age and unit size are controlled for by using hedonic regressions and price movements are aggregated using 5-quarter fixed weights to derive the aggregate price change.  Data are compiled from caveats lodged at Singapore Land Authority, stamp duty data from the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore, as well as data provided by developers.
scope: Private residential sales; excludes HDB flats and other public-sector buildings. Non-landed price coverage includes executive condominiums more than ten years old. It is an aggregate index, not a dwelling price in dollars.

mechanism.sales: Observed private residential sale-price outcome for exploratory evaluation; not an explanatory candidate.
mechanism.rents: Not a rental index; assess rental outcomes separately.
mechanism.lag: No predictive lag is established by the outcome definition.
mechanism.limitations: The current-base history includes a methodology change in 2015 Q1. Do not splice older-base downloads into this series. Aggregation, rounding and later revisions limit comparisons; matched index bases do not imply matched housing coverage. The series is not labelled seasonally adjusted.

availability_note: Latest downloaded vintage. Table update date is not an observation release date; historical information availability is not reconstructed.
evaluation_note: Use changes rather than index levels for exploratory association checks. For a common post-methodology window, retain comparison endpoints from 2015 Q1 onward: the first within-window quarter-on-quarter change is 2015 Q2 and the first year-on-year change is 2016 Q1. This is an analyst comparability restriction, not an official finding of predictive validity. The captured latest vintage cannot reconstruct historical release timing or revisions.

name: Rental Index Of Residential Properties
definition: URA overall private residential rental index, based on tenancy-agreement data; 2009 Q1 = 100. Stratified hedonic regression is used from 2015 Q1.
update_frequency: Quarterly. URA states that its time-series service updates on the fourth Friday of January, April, July and October, or the following working day after a public holiday. This upstream schedule is not a guaranteed SingStat mirror update time; individual historical release dates are not reconstructed.
table_title: Rental Index Of Residential Properties, (1st Quarter 2009 = 100), Quarterly
source_footnote: From 1Q 2015, the private residential property rental indices are computed using a stratified hedonic regression method.  Under this method, variations in the attributes of rental private residential properties transacted such as age and unit size are controlled for by using hedonic regressions and rental movements are aggregated using 5-quarter fixed weights to derive the aggregate rental change.  Rental indices are computed from data on rentals provided by the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore.
scope: Private landed and non-landed rentals, including executive condominiums; excludes HDB flats and other public-sector buildings. It is an aggregate index, not monthly rent in dollars or a measure of HDB rents.

mechanism.sales: Not a sale-price index; assess sales outcomes separately.
mechanism.rents: Observed private residential rental outcome for exploratory evaluation; not an explanatory candidate.
mechanism.lag: No predictive lag is established by the outcome definition.
mechanism.limitations: The current-base history includes a methodology change in 2015 Q1. Do not splice older-base downloads into this series. Rental coverage differs from the sale-price index and from private stock series that exclude executive condominiums. Aggregation, rounding and later revisions limit comparisons. The series is not labelled seasonally adjusted.

name: HDB Resale Price Index
definition: HDB resale flat price index based on registered resale transactions; 2009 Q1 = 100. The method changes from stratification to stratified hedonic regression in 2014 Q4.
update_frequency: Quarterly observation frequency in official metadata; expected update cadence is inferred, not guaranteed. The SingStat mirror schedule and individual historical observation release dates are not confirmed.
table_title: Housing And Development Board (HDB) Resale Price Index (1Q2009 = 100), Quarterly
source_footnote: The index is based on quarterly average resale price by date of registration.  The index till 3Q2014 was computed using stratification method, while that from 4Q2014 onwards is computed using the stratified hedonic regression method.  1Q2009 is adopted as the new base period with index at 100.  The index from 1Q1990 to 3Q2014 are rebased to the new base period at 1Q2009.  Indices from 1Q1990 to 3Q2014 are re-scaled using a factor of 100 (new index in 1Q2009) / 138.3 (original index in 1Q2009) multiplied on the original index level to derive the re-based index level for the respective quarters.  Due to rounding, there could be some differences in the quarterly price change compared to the RPI series before re-scaling.
scope: HDB resale flats; a public-housing resale outcome distinct from private residential sale prices, new HDB sale prices and HDB rents.

mechanism.sales: Observed HDB resale price outcome for a separate public-housing comparison; not an explanatory candidate.
mechanism.rents: Not a rental index and cannot establish HDB rental movements.
mechanism.lag: No predictive lag is established by the outcome definition.
mechanism.limitations: The current series rescales 1990 Q1 through 2014 Q3 by 100/138.3 to the 2009 Q1 base; source metadata warns that rounding can change quarterly percentage movements relative to the earlier release. The method changes in 2014 Q4. Keep public resale, private sales and rents separate; latest-vintage revisions are not historical information sets.
